module: Asynchronous loader for large datasets (vehicles, missions, gameplay selector, levels, career save profiles). Each loadXxx starts a job (core_jobsystem, 1/30 s interval) that runs the heavy loading while yielding between steps, publishes progress in the 'asyncBulkLoaderProgress' stream and signals completion via guihooks and extensions.hook. The xxxDirect variants load synchronously with time measurement.
usage:
local r = util_asyncBulkLoader.loadVehicles()
-- r is 'alreadyLoaded', 'alreadyLoading' or 'startLoading'
-- completion is announced by the asyncVehicleLoadComplete hook
notes: Return values of the loadXxx functions: 'alreadyLoaded' (data already loaded), 'alreadyLoading' (another load is in progress, error logged with trace) or 'startLoading'. Only one load at a time (isLoading).
'asyncBulkLoaderProgress' stream: {count, total, inProgress, percent}. percent: 0 to 100 = determinate, -1 = indeterminate. Only loadVehicles resets percent to -1.

End of load: loadVehicles emits guihooks 'asyncVehicleLoadComplete' and the hook of the same name; loadMissions emits only the guihook 'asyncMissionLoadComplete' (no extensions hook); loadGameplaySelector emits 'asyncGameplaySelectorLoadComplete' (guihook and hook); loadLevels emits 'asyncLevelLoadComplete' (guihook and hook).

The profiling threshold tooLongLoadingThreshold is math.huge: profiling (startProfiling, profileLow, profileHigh, stopProfiling) is replaced by nop. Lowering it writes an asyncBulkLoader_report.json report for loads that take too long.
Probable bug: loadLevels sets M.yield to nil at the end; any later call to M.yield without a new setupYield would cause an error (the other loads reset nop or a new yield).
sendAllCareerSaveSlotsDataAsync loads nothing itself (the test code is commented out): it starts a job then calls career_career.sendAllCareerProfilesData() and returns only 'startLoading'.

yield.desc: Yield function (job.yield) set by setupYield; nop at start. Called by the loading code to let the game breathe.

reportStream.desc: Sends the current progress state in the 'asyncBulkLoaderProgress' stream.

reportScanPercent.desc: Updates the percentage of file parsing (decoding of vehicles) and publishes the progress.

addTotal.desc: Adds to the total number of items to load and publishes the progress.

total.desc: Items to add to the total.

addCount.desc: Adds to the number of items already processed and publishes the progress.

isVehiclesLoaded.desc: Returns whether the vehicle model data is loaded (core_vehicles.isModelsDataLoaded).

isMissionsLoaded.desc: Returns whether all missions are loaded.

isGameplaySelectorLoaded.desc: Returns whether the gameplay selector data is loaded.

isLevelsLoaded.desc: Returns whether the level list is loaded (core_levels.isListLoaded).

loadVehiclesDirect.desc: Loads the vehicle model list synchronously (core_vehicles.loadModelListNoGarbage) and prints the time.

loadMissionsDirect.desc: Loads all missions synchronously and prints the time.

loadGameplaySelectorDirect.desc: Builds the gameplay selector tiles synchronously and prints the time.

loadLevelsDirect.desc: Loads the level list synchronously and prints the time.

isLoading.desc: Returns whether an asynchronous load is in progress.

setupYield.desc: Prepares M.yield from a job: job.yield, or a profiled version if the threshold is lowered.

loadVehicles.desc: Loads the vehicle model data asynchronously, then emits 'asyncVehicleLoadComplete' (UI and extensions). Used by the vehicle selector.

loadMissions.desc: Loads all missions asynchronously, then emits the guihook 'asyncMissionLoadComplete'.

loadGameplaySelector.desc: Builds the gameplay selector data asynchronously, then emits 'asyncGameplaySelectorLoadComplete'.

loadLevels.desc: Loads the level list asynchronously, then emits 'asyncLevelLoadComplete'.

sendAllCareerSaveSlotsDataAsync.desc: In a job, sends the UI the data of all career save slots (career_career.sendAllCareerProfilesData).
